description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is a Set of 2 Suzuki OEM Shackles for the Front or Rear Leaf Springs
This kit also includes the Bushings & Spacers for the leaf springs and the shackles
Does Front or Rear Leaf Springs
Suzuki OEM
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 8 – Small Bushings
Qty 2 – Inner Shackles
Qty 2 – Outer Shackles
Qty 2 – Spacers
Qty 4 – Large Bushings
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
